gap: Replace the hard polygon verge and card-like foliage with continuous grounded terrain and blended material transitions that preserve believable near/mid/far landscape depth in every season and camera.
secondary_gaps: Golden hour remains pale and washed out instead of the bar's saturated amber fields and coherent long shadows.
Night has stars and a readable road, but the terrain collapses into near-black silhouettes and the headlight pool is weak versus the bar's shoreline/mountain context.
Winter communicates a white palette but leaves exposed shoulder polygons and a dark normal road rather than a continuous snow world.
Cockpit framing is recognizable but the oversized dark dashboard and missing mirror/A-pillar realism diverge strongly from the bar.
The elevated vista has a clear road and bridge but lacks the bar's water-backed composition and layered atmospheric ridges.

evidence.note: Bar wins with rolling lake-backed hills, continuous grass and a finished scenic composition. Ours has denser stylized foliage and a legible road, but faceted crowns, repeated clumps and flat pale verge planes remain dominant.
Bar wins decisively with saturated warm fields, low-sun contrast and long shadows. Ours is overexposed toward the sun, with gray-green ground and weak shadow structure.

Bar retains shoreline and mountain context, a readable blue night ramp and a strong headlight cone. Ours supplies stars, tail lights and a visible ribbon, but most terrain collapses into dark low-poly silhouettes.

Bar has a credible mirror, A-pillar, road and hillside under flat cloud light. Ours establishes a cockpit, but the oversized dark slab dashboard fills the lower frame and autumn vegetation is visibly faceted.
Bar is a coherent snow world with sculpted snow relief. Ours changes trees and ground toward white but leaves exposed polygon shoulder patches, sparse clumps and a normal dark road.
Bar's elevated frame has smooth cut slope, water and multiple atmospheric ridge layers. Ours has a readable elevated road/bridge but remains a flat green patchwork without comparable depth.

Bar's driver view is restrained and photographic with mirror, A-pillar and road cut. Ours has a centered road and detailed wheel, but noisy dark interior, oversized dash and low-poly verge are unmistakable.

verdict_text: Independent round-16 seven-shot blind review: the official bar wins all seven comparisons and the randomized side call is correct 7/7. Organic per-instance foliage masks improve silhouette variety, but the global read remains procedural low-poly scenery; hard verge planes, faceted vegetation and missing continuous landform depth dominate every camera and season.
